name: byparr-mcp
description: Expose a FlareSolverr-compatible solver (Byparr/FlareSolverr) as MCP tools for Codex, mcporter and other MCP clients. Configure the solver address in Settings.

solver_url.label: Solver URL
solver_url.description: Base URL of your Byparr or FlareSolverr instance. Stored as a forwarded variable and passed to the MCP server. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8191 when unset.
